quote: Knowledge is the beginning of action and action is the completion of knowledge. Learning to be a sage involves only one effort. Knowledge and action should not be separated.
source: Wang Yangming, Instructions for Practical Living, Part I, section 26 (trans. Wing-tsit Chan, 1963)
